verdict.rationale: Activepieces publishes its source in a public GitHub repository described as 'An open source replacement for Zapier'. Its own llms.txt calls it 'Open-source', and a community commenter independently notes the MIT license. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license terms in the evidence (e.g. the LICENSE file), and clarity on whether any parts of the codebase sit outside the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
